design_philosophy: A modern Canva + Figma + Construction Estimator studio workspace. Clean, crisp, precise, light-theme primary with subtle studio chrome tones. Designed for homeowners, contractors, architects, and engineers to visually create floor plans and automatically calculate bill of quantities (RAB - Rencana Anggaran Biaya).

theme.style_vibe: Studio Workspace & High-Precision Tool (Figma / Canva / Linear style)

mono_numeric.usage: Used for dimensions, canvas coordinates, currency values, RAB quantities, and unit prices for high-precision clarity

chrome.left_tool_rail: w-16 bg-white border-r border-slate-200 flex flex-col items-center py-3 gap-2 z-20 shrink-0

key_components_and_features.name: Dashboard & Project Hub
key_components_and_features.description: Grid of project cards with status, building dimensions, total area, live estimated cost ($), floor count, thumbnail preview, search, and 'Create New Plan' modal.

key_components_and_features.name: Project Setup Wizard
key_components_and_features.description: Form for configuring project name, client name, site location, land length/width, building dimensions, number of floors, target budget, default currency (USD), and material class preset.

key_components_and_features.name: 2D Floor Planner Canvas Studio
key_components_and_features.description: Interactive HTML5 canvas/SVG editor supporting panning, zooming (10%-500%), major/minor grid snapping, wall drawing/stretching, auto room polygon detection with area (m² / sq ft), placement of doors, windows, structural columns, utility markers, live dynamic dimension indicators, undo/redo history stack, and ghost layer floor overlay.

key_components_and_features.name: Multi-Floor Manager
key_components_and_features.description: Floor navigation bar (Ground Floor, 1st Floor, 2nd Floor, Roof) with ability to duplicate floor layout, set floor height (e.g., 3.2m), and view lower floor as translucent ghost reference layer.

key_components_and_features.name: Element Property Inspector
key_components_and_features.description: Contextual right sidebar that updates based on selection (Wall, Door, Window, Column, Room, Utility Point). Allows editing thickness, height, material type, opening width, unit unit-cost preview, and custom naming.

key_components_and_features.name: RAB Construction Estimator Engine & Table
key_components_and_features.description: Automated quantity takeoff engine that converts 2D wall lines, room areas, doors, windows, and utility counts into construction quantities (m³, m², meters, units). Displays detailed RAB spreadsheet table grouped by category with live unit prices, AHSP labor/material breakdown, subtotals, overhead/profit adjustment, and direct jump-to-drawing trigger.

key_components_and_features.name: Cost Analytics & Executive Summary
key_components_and_features.description: Dashboard with graphical cost breakdown charts (Cost per m², Structure vs Architecture vs MEP vs Exterior breakdown), Material vs Labor vs Contractor Fee distribution, and room-by-room cost breakdown.

key_components_and_features.name: Price & Material Resource Database
key_components_and_features.description: Editable master rate database for cement, sand, brick, rebar, paint, labor per day, tile per m², and fixture unit prices that dynamically recalculate the entire RAB.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure state persistence using localStorage so created projects, drawings, floor plans, and custom RAB prices persist across browser reloads.

The drawing canvas MUST serve as the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for RAB quantity calculations. Modifying walls, adding rooms, or adding doors/windows MUST dynamically update quantities in the RAB table in real-time.
Do NOT force AutoCAD complex controls. Make drawing intuitive like Canva/Figma: drag to draw walls, click to select, drag handles to move/resize, auto-snap to grid and nearest wall endpoints.

Provide sample default starter project templates (e.g. 'Modern 2-Story 3BR Family Residence', 'Minimalist Compact Studio 45m²', 'Luxury Pavilion House') so users can immediately test the 2D planner and RAB calculations upon opening.
Use USD ($) as default currency label with option to toggle currency display or custom rate multiplier.
Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, and canvas toolbar items include the required data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy in dashboard and inspector panels (p-4 to p-6). Tight studio alignment in canvas chrome.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.animations: Framer motion micro-interactions for tab switching, sidebar expand/collapse, project card hovers, and toast notifications (Sonner).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: High contrast text and sharp crisp borders (border-slate-200 / border-slate-300) to ensure readability for technical measurements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use Sonner for user actions (e.g. Project Saved, Floor Duplicated, RAB Exported).
